description: For any finite family of finite index sets, the intersection of their finite-domain cones is the cone of their union; the empty intersection is the whole space of finite domains.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.RadoHall.finite_cones_intersection.{u} {ι : Type u} [DecidableEq ι] (B : Finset (Finset ι)) :
  ⋂ s ∈ B, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.RadoHall.FiniteCone s = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.RadoHall.FiniteCone (B.biUnion id)
